I thought you guys might like these...

![](upload://vHkUtrz500kw6V6kaKhWFMDK4e3.jpeg)

 

![](upload://oj34CEx5kNIUJT6eCIywgVwZMfP.jpeg)

 

Each card is a front and back printed on card stock, so it's very sturdy and snaps like a real card.  Obviously some of the backs have a clipping issue where a bit of white shows, but all in all they will do nicely until I get the real things.

Oh, and I used a bit of creative freedome with America's Greatest Legacy for his defeated side, using an image from the Iron Legacy deck and the rules text from Young Legacy's card.
